sentence: That cooperation leads toward the grounding, bounding and recasting capabilities the theory names, in what the authors call one of the first empirical applications of situated AI
passage: [Vaillant et al. (2025), sec. 6.1] "It was found that such usage does indeed facilitate cooperation during the problem identification and solution implementation stages, and, as predicted by the theory of situated AI, this cooperation leads solution ecosystems towards greater AI-driven situating capabilities, namely, those attained through grounding, bounding, and recasting." / [sec. 6.2] "this is one of the first studies to empirically apply the situated AI theory."

gemini.note: The passage explicitly confirms both that cooperation leads to the mentioned capabilities and that the authors consider this one of the first empirical applications of the theory.
